# qrcode-generator (vendored)

`qrcode.js` is qrcode-generator 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, copied unchanged from the npm package
(`npm pack qrcode-generator@1.4.4`) so Stage 3D can draw the job-sheet QR code offline under its
`script-src 'self'` policy. Licensed under the MIT license (see the header of `qrcode.js`).
